correctness.rationale: The exact chain-level signed Lefschetz identity accounts for each selected orbit and the augmentation. For a rotation, the 4x4 transfer matrix has characteristic polynomial x(x−1)(x²+1), giving 1+2 cos(pi gcd(n,a)/2) for every exponent, including small orbit periods. For reflections, a complete half-cycle orbit classification gives two forbidden endpoint pairs and a four-periodic matrix product. These traces uniquely identify rational modules using Taylan’s proved homology concentration; exact averaging yields quotient ranks. Standalone finite tests checked 330 dihedral actions and 22 full prime-field homology computations, supporting but not replacing the symbolic proof.

originality.rationale: The exact prior cycle three-path-devoid homotopy theorem establishes only sphere multiplicities and degrees. It does not calculate the action of generators of the dihedral group, the rank-three square constituent, or the mod-eight dihedral-invariant quotient pattern. Four published superficially related results were read in full; their defining face predicates differ, so neither their homology characters nor their nonequivariant results imply the proposed claim. Searches did not identify a direct equivalent, but priority outside inspected sources is not guaranteed.

value.rationale: A standard infinite family of nonflag cyclic-avoidance complexes has a known but atypical triple sphere-wedge when the length is divisible by four. The new group-module classification explains the anomaly as an inflated square irreducible together with a parity-sensitive line, and yields an exact all-length mod-eight homology classification of natural symmetry quotients. These are canonical topological invariants inaccessible from the previous nonequivariant Betti table.
